title: weathered
body:
i love the rain.
the way the water bends the light around it and makes
even the dullest objects shine in spite of the overcast.
each drop punching into the dust and remnants we leave
on the surfaces we impart our worries.
the runoff pulling the them from the land and drawing them far
far away through the rapids into to the stillness at the bottom of the sea.

and for a moment, the world stands still.
nestled warmly in its burrows,
baton lifted, to catch its breath
in the rhapsody.
indulging in the pluvial static.

the land needs a good cry every once and a while.
